P01.rationale: No human portrait or founder image appears anywhere on the page; it is entirely text and a QR code.

P05.rationale: There are no case study sections or client portraits present on this page.

P07.rationale: No press logos, rating cards, review grid, or testimonials are present; the page is purely a call-to-action/contact page.

P10.rationale: No oversized ghost numerals, large quote glyphs, or decorative typographic elements are used.

P11.rationale: No data visualisations, charts, before/after comparisons, or cost-math graphics appear on the page.

P12.rationale: The layout is extremely sparse with large empty regions dominating the lower two-thirds of the sheet, far from magazine-quality density.

P13.rationale: A dark navy background provides a minimal atmospheric tone, but there is no texture, grain, or layered visual atmosphere beyond a flat colour field.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page, so the criterion is not applicable.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) is present on the page.

N07.rationale: The page contains no imagery at all beyond a QR code, so stock-photo genericness is not a significant issue, though the QR code itself is generic.

N08.rationale: Vast empty dark space occupies roughly half the page between the headline block and the URL, and again below the URL to the QR code, creating severe dead whitespace.

N10.rationale: There is no photo background under any text, so no scrim or readability issue exists.
